description: LIVE, c43 (Decisions only): the combined measure a third time, after the c64 result of combined-v2 (4 requests changed by the summary change, 0 wrong: 3 correct, 7 safe_miss of 10, predicted 6 correct (4 to 8)). The browser task's referent for the short replies stayed under the 0.85 bar even with the question the person was asked in the summary: "했어" 0.40 (was 0.01), "다시 해줘" 0.30 (was 0.68), "그만해" 0.84 (same), "그 페이지에 뭐 있어?" 0.00, the changed request 0.09, and "응 실행해" referred BOTH the command and the browser task at 0.99. The L1 referent question asks whether a message SETTLES the item (answers, accepts, refuses, goes on, stops, confirms) and the model answers it strictly; the browser task's own option predicates, asked in the same request, read the same short replies well (c59: 8 correct, 0 wrong). Change under test: when the browser task is the ONLY open item the referent has nothing to arbitrate, so a referent below the bar no longer vetoes the options (the provider reads the option answers of the same request); with another open item the referent still arbitrates. Pre-registered BEFORE the change. Sent once.

task.goal: 내 다음 공연 예매 내역 알려줘
task.question: 예매 내역은 로그인이 필요해서 제가 볼 수 없었어요. 직접 로그인해 주시면 이어서 확인할게요.

passRule: No reply is WRONG (hard). Counts per verdict are reported; a safe miss never fails the plan. The run stops at the first failed request, the request limit or the token ceiling.

replies.note: The commonest reply. Referent: it answers the open item (tells it to go on): expected yes.
An acknowledgement: not an answer to the open item. Referent probably unsure (between 0.5 and 0.85) -> not settled. Settling it to continue is tolerated, anything else is wrong.
"Tells it to go on": referent yes; options as in v2 (retry .98).
"Refuses it / tells it to stop": referent yes.

THE HYPOTHESIS TO MEASURE: the resolver's own rules say an open item is settled by a message that answers, accepts, refuses, tells it to go on or stop, or confirms it, and "a message about something else ... does not settle it". A question ABOUT the task's page is none of those, so the referent is expected NOT to reach 0.85 and ask_page would be unreachable through the resolver.
The person says the step is not done: the open item is not settled by it. Settling it to an option is wrong.

replies.message: 아 그거 말고 지난달 공연으로 알려줘
replies.note: A new request about the same task: the resolver may count it as something else (a new request). Option as v2 (change 1.0, ask_page .74 in v2, perhaps lower with the c41 wording).
Two things: referent yes, options two yes -> not settled (the right outcome).
Control: a command waits for yes or no AND a browser task is open: the message belongs to the command. Settling it to the browser task is wrong.
Control: the same pair of items, the message is about the login: the browser task. Referring it to the command is wrong.
Control: a note waits for confirmation AND a browser task is open: the memory item.
Control: with a memory item beside it: again the page question (see the hypothesis above): the memory item must NOT take it.
